item.name: Jotform
item.summary: Read Jotform forms and submissions, create submissions, download uploads and manage webhooks.
item.description:
Connect workflows to Jotform, the online form builder, through its REST API. Everyday steps list forms and their questions, read a form's new submissions with a cursor that continues where the last run stopped, read one submission, create a submission, download an uploaded file and manage a form's webhooks.

52 operations of the Jotform API documentation have their own step. A connection is one Jotform account's API key and its region: standard, EU or HIPAA.
item.setup_summary: Create an API key in Jotform (My Account → API), add it and the account's region to the connection and run the connection test.
